data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Socratic Grilling & Prompting in Multi-Agent Systems — User-Facing Discovery, Agent-to-Agent Adversarial Verification, Cache-Preserving Scratchpads, and Memory Distillation
data.description: Deep-dive OKF architecture specification for Socratic Grilling and Prompting in Multi-Agent Systems: (1) Interactive Agent-to-User Socratic discovery chatbots with information-gain question bundling and Context-Clash (-39%) prevention; (2) Autonomous Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Socratic grilling across Authority-Gradient handshakes, Generator-Critic-Reflector loops, and MCE 5-Gate audits; (3) AKV Cache-Preserving Socratic Scratchpads; and (4) Multi-Tier Memory Distillation.
